questions.question: If the exact personally possessed casting route fixed at Flora acquisition is later unavailable, what happens to new creation, existing plants, their DC, commands and armed automatic entry? Distinguish permanent loss and temporary suppression only where current sources do. The numerical DC projection alone does not authorize a use; do not invent a fallback route or reacquisition.

A level10+ first plant is destroyed, uprooted, burst or otherwise ends before its original minute deadline. Does its still-unused second paid-Action creation permission end immediately or survive until that deadline? The phrase before that first seedling expires may not settle early termination. Existing first body must remain ended and every paid use/deadline/history must remain conserved.

A character creates at total8/9, then genuinely reaches total10 before the first plant original deadline. Is the second-creation eligibility fixed at commitment or live while that use remains open? The local level8-creation-then-level10-capacity history assumed fixed eligibility; this is an UNAPPROVED inference, not a source ruling. Decide the governing rule before this check is relied on. No charge/body/HP refill follows merely from capacity growth.

For the later split command/attached-phase implementation, bind temporary owner incapacity, owner death and loss of command channel after a legal commitment to the existing actual companion sources. The current local model collapses a legal command and its immediate phase into one operation, so it does not prove intervening-event behavior. State any genuinely missing Flora-specific rule explicitly as NEW; do not silently inherit Animal Companion death or release rules.
